_comment: Baked daiyooo-vfx effects for monster moves (client/monster_vfx.gd; display only, the rules never read this). Key = '<event>/<id>': 'area_placed/<area id>' plays at the ground area the rules just marked (scaled by the area radius / ref_radius, started at 'seek' seconds so the clip's own burst lands when the area detonates), 'attack_started/<move id>' plays on the attacker (follow = stays on it), 'projectile_fired/<projectile id>' plays at the shot's release point turned along its flight (face; forward/lift = metres to move the asset origin along the flight / up, for a bundle whose own flight starts off its origin), 'wave_arrived/<enemy type>' plays under every monster of the wave that brings that type (boss_scale for the bosses, scale for the rest). vfx = the bundle folder under res://art/vfx/monster/ (effect.tscn + effect.glb + recipe.json from the daiyooo-vfx MCP). speed = playback rate. The Mummy High Wizard's kit (combat-designer 2026-11-18): golden bolt, curse circle, starfall marks, sandstorm, and the summoning circles its escorts rise from.
